name: airtime-api
description: This is an API to order Vodacom, Cell C, MTN and Telkom Airtime and Data

paragraphs: This is an API that enables you to order Vodacom, Cell C, MTN and Telkom Airtime and Data.
On the Development Server use note the "http" and .test subdomain.
The USER number is in fact the number associated with your account in our system, which is in turn associated with the mobile number used during registration.

whatItDoes.text: This is an API that enables you to order Vodacom, Cell C, MTN and Telkom Airtime and Data.

requirements.text: To get started it will be best to create an account on the Development Server with FREEPAID (link below).

The response will be a PIN number and the serial number for the voucher, with cost price and remaining balance. (You can also use the order number to re-order old vouchers, for example if you need to do a reprint).
To find the USER number for the Development site login at click on Reports, then SMS log, and find the first SMS we sent you.
